title: Spellseeking Gloves
summary: Spend a Sorcery Point to gain advantage on a spell attack.

fields.Seeking Spell: Toggle on to gain advantage on a spell attack, costing 1 Sorcery Point per spell slot level, or 1 point for a cantrip. The toggle turns off after the cast.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
